answer: Require every agent to register through one credential-bound bond: 400 POA locked for 90 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication. The bond key signs a single non-transferable pearl attestation, and splitting that credential across two identities slashes both at once. Verification is public: anyone can audit the meadow vault and the attestation ledger in seconds, and grading weight starts at zero until five epochs of accurate grading. A knoll of 1,000 fakes costs 400,000 POA locked and unrecoverable, plus 5,000 epochs of graded work. Fakes cannot buy trust in bulk.
